title: SIDESTORY: FIRST OF A THOUSAND AUTUMNS OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: FIRST OF A THOUSAND AUTUMNS OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: First of A Thousand Autumns event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
- Phase 1 [Record of An Autumn's End]
DURATION: July 16, 2026, 08:00 - August 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 2 [Forgotten Prospect of Spring]
DURATION: July 23, 2026, 16:00 - August 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 3 [Unwritten Chapters of Yan]
DURATION: July 30, 2026, 16:00 - August 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Proofreading of the Past]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Proofreading of the Past] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Ju], Sky Mirror Pavilion Reception Hall Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, 'Draft of History', etc.
[Sky Mirror Teahouse]

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain 'Draft of History' by clearing event stages and completing [Proofreading of the Past]. 'Draft of History' can be used to redeem items from [Sky Mirror Teahouse].

REWARDS: Ju's Token, Sky Mirror Pavilion Reception Hall Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, 0011 Collection - Tremble Cold for Whisperain, EPOQUE Collection - Light and Shadow for Nightmare, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – ASHES TO ASHES, AGES ON AGES
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Ashes to Ashes, Ages on Ages], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Wang [Limited] / Ch'en the Dawnstreak
★★★★★★: Yu [Limited] / Shu [Limited] / Chongyue [Limited]
★★★★★: Taraxacum

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator Wang after a total of 300 rolls (once only). This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get the next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting].
NOTE:
- [Ashes to Ashes, Ages on Ages] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Festival] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Festival] is Limited Headhunting.
- Ch'en the Dawnstreak and Taraxacum will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after July 30, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Operator Wang is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.

- Operator Dusk will be available in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] during [Limited Headhunting - Festival]. The required Headhunting Data Contracts for Dusk will be reduced from 300 to 200 starting this headhunting.
Available Operators from the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop]:
★★★★★★ (300 Headhunting Data Contract): Wang / Ch'en the Dawnstreak / Yu / Shu / Chongyue / Ling
★★★★★★ (200 Headhunting Data Contract): Dusk / Nian
★★★★★ (75 Headhunting Data Contract): Taraxacum
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 ASHES TO ASHES, AGES ON AGES LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: Players can log in during the event to claim reward on event page: Moon Night Homecoming Headhunting Permit * 1
NOTE:
- Moon Night Homecoming Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Ashes to Ashes, Ages on Ages] Limited Headhunting.
- Moon Night Homecoming Headhunting Permit expires at: July 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
04 DAILY FREE ROLL IN [ASHES TO ASHES, AGES ON AGES] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [Ashes to Ashes, Ages on Ages] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE: - Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day. - Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
★★★★★★: Wang [Limited]
★★★★★★: Ch'en the Dawnstreak
★★★★★: Taraxacum
DETAILS:
- Wang is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any [Standard Headhunting].

- Operator Ju is currently ONLY available from First of A Thousand Autumns event, and is NOT available in [Ashes to Ashes, Ages on Ages] Limited Headhunting, [Standard Headhunting] or [Kernel Headhunting].
- Operators Ch'en the Dawnstreak and Taraxacum will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after July 30, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- From July 16, 2026, 08:00 to August 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7), Operators Wang, Ch'en the Dawnstreak, Taraxacum, and Ju will gain more trust in the event stages.
06 LUNGMEN LUCKY STRIPS OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Lucky Strips each day upon login. Consume trials to select Lucky Strips as permitted in [Lungmen Lucky Strips]. The Lucky Strip with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Lucky Strips.
- Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Lucky Strips:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.

[Festival Supply Pack]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 30, Outfit Voucher * 1, Automatic Chip Pack Etcher * 1, Advanced Material Voucher * 8, Tactical Battle Record * 50, LMD * 100,000

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 19, Top Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Top Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 90. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 11, Senior Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Senior Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 5-star Operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 80. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.

CONTENTS: Headhunting Permit * 1, Kernel Headhunting Permit * 1, Module Data Block *1, LMD * 10,000

Top Operator Skill Training Pack: You can select a 6-star Operator that meets the requirements and level a skill to Specialization Level 3.

CONTENTS: Ten-roll Kernel Headhunting Permit * 1
Guard Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Guard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Specialist Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Specialist Dualchip * 4, Specialist Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
10 NEW FURNITURE SET – YU'S KITCHEN & SKY MIRROR PAVILION RECEPTION HALL
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed Furniture, Yu's Kitchen, and Sky Mirror Pavilion Reception Hall will be available during the event.
Yu's Kitchen
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Limited-time sale at the Store: July 16, 2026, 08:00 - August 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Sky Mirror Pavilion Reception Hall
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- First of A Thousand Autumns event rewards and redeem in Sky Mirror Teahouse (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces): July 16, 2026, 08:00 - August 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

★★★★★★: Passenger (This Specialized Module can take effect in [Reclamation Algorithm])

During the update, tags that have not yet been used for Recruit will be refreshed. Please stay tuned for further information.

Bloodline of Combat Collection - Dreadnaught for Beagle
14 2026 FESTIVAL SIGN-IN

DETAILS: During the event period, players can log in on July 16, July 19, July 22, and July 25 to receive specific Operator blessings along with a certain amount of Orundum. The received blessings can be added to players' own collection of Blessings. Additionally, the Operator blessings can be shared or saved as wallpapers. Players can log in for a total of 10 days to receive event-exclusive Furniture, Module Materials, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, among other rewards.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Chip Catalyst * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 4: Strategic Battle Record * 10, Sugar Pack * 3
Day 5: LMD * 30000, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 6: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, Crystalline Component * 3
Day 7: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Pure Gold * 20
Day 8: Exclusive Furniture - 'Festival' Lightbox * 1, Furniture Part * 300
Day 9: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Orirock Cluster * 3
Day 10: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 1 * 30
NOTE:
- Each Operator blessing can be obtained only once.
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
15 SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event period, players can receive gift emails from different Operators at various time intervals.
ELIGIBILITY: Players who registered and named the Doctor before July 16, 2026, 20:00 (UTC-7).
NOTE:
- The details of the gifts and the email delivery will be determined based on the actual event.
- The event emails will be valid for 7 days. Please remember to claim them in time.
